items.title: Bitcoin vs its 200-week moving average
items.description: Bitcoin's weekly price against its 200-week moving average, on a log scale, since mid-2019.
items.reason: Bitcoin closed Friday at about $58,800, 14% below its 200-week average of about $68,100, the deepest discount since March 2023, after falling to about $55K overnight, its lowest since September 2024.

items.title: Strategy: bitcoin held vs its average purchase cost
items.description: Strategy's bitcoin holdings (in thousands of BTC) and its average purchase cost per bitcoin, against the bitcoin price, weekly since August 2020.
items.reason: With bitcoin near $60K, Strategy's 850,849 BTC (Nov 16 8-K) are worth about $51B, roughly 20% below their $64.2B cost, or $75,452 per coin.

items.title: Tesla's active FSD subscriptions: 1.74M, up 67% in a year (Q3 2026)
items.description: Tesla's active FSD subscriptions (upfront purchases plus monthly subscriptions, excluding free trials) by quarter from Tesla's updates: 0.95M in Q2 2025 to 1.74M in Q3 2026.
items.reason: Musk said this morning that FSD V15 goes to wide release in December with the holiday update.

items.title: Hyperscaler free cash flow (incl. SpaceX)
items.description: Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon and SpaceX free cash flow, 2014–2030E. Combined FCF is estimated to trough around –$408bn in 2027 (SpaceX, incl. xAI & X, –$315bn) before rebounding in 2030. Actuals from SEC 10-Ks; estimates from S&P Global consensus, company capex guidance and Steve's DCF (updated Nov 20, 2026).
items.reason: SpaceX priced about $44B of GPU financing led by Apollo and Goldman, including $32B of bonds whose largest tranche yields 8.259%, as AI stocks sold off.

items.title: VIX term structure: 3-month vs 1-month implied vol
items.description: The VIX term structure: 3-month implied volatility (VIX3M) divided by the 1-month VIX, weekly since July 2019, with the VIX itself. A ratio below 1 means near-term fear is higher than longer-term.
items.reason: The VIX jumped about 37% on Friday to 38.83, its highest close since April 2025, as the S&P 500 and Dow closed in correction.
